title: Optimal Regret Lower Bounds in Matrix Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.31149v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study learning in two-player zero-sum games, also known as matrix games, in which two players with $m$ and $n$ actions repeatedly select mixed strategies for $T$ rounds. The learning dynamics based on optimistic Hedge guarantee regrets of $O(\log(mn))$, which improve to $O(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$ if each player knows the number of actions of the opponent, whereas matching regret lower bounds have been known only for specific learning dynamics. We prove that, for every deterministic learning dynamic, there exists a payoff matrix for which the maximum individual regret is $\Omega(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$ for a wide range of $m$ and $n$. Together with the upper bound $O(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$, this lower bound shows that the minimax regret of deterministic learning dynamics in matrix games is $\Theta(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$ in this regime. translated_title: 矩阵博弈中的最优后悔下界
translated_abstract: 我们研究双人零和博弈（也称为矩阵博弈）中的学习问题，其中分别拥有 $m$ 和 $n$ 个动作的两名玩家在 $T$ 轮中反复选择混合策略。基于乐观 Hedge 的学习动力学可保证 $O(\log(mn))$ 的后悔；如果每个玩家知道对手的动作数量，该界可改进为 $O(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$，然而与之匹配的后悔下界此前仅对特定学习动力学已知。我们证明，对于任意确定性学习动力学，都存在一个收益矩阵，使得在广泛的 $m$ 和 $n$ 范围内，最大个体后悔为 $\Omega(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$。结合上界 $O(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$，该下界表明在此范围内，矩阵博弈中确定性学习动力学的极小极大后悔为 $\Theta(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$。对于所有的 $m$、$n$ 和 $T$，我们还证明了下界 $\Omega(\min\{T,\log\min\{m,n\}\})$。
tldr: 本文为矩阵博弈中所有确定性学习动力学证明了 $\Omega(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$ 的后悔下界，与已知上界匹配，从而确定了该情形下极小极大后悔的精确阶 $\Theta(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$。
en_tdlr: This paper proves an $\Omega(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$ regret lower bound for every deterministic learning dynamic in matrix games, matching the known upper bound and establishing that the minimax regret is $\Theta(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$ in this regime.
